mapper.select: select r.pno, r.uno, r.rstar, r.rimage, r.rcontent, r.rdelete , r.rregdate, r.rmoddate, u.uno, p.pno from tbl_review r inner join tbl_user u on r.uno = u.uno left join tbl_product p on r.pno = p.pno where r.rno = #{rno} and r.rdelete = false
select count(r.rno) from tbl_review r where r.rno = #{rno} and r.rdelete = false
